concept_name: Vibrio cholerae live attenuated Powder for Oral Suspension [Vaxchora]
comment: EMA presentation contains 400000000 to 2000000000 viable CVD 103-HgR cells per dose in active and buffer sachets. Extension preserves the powder-for-reconstitution form and brand but omits explicit strain and potency; a fixed 12000000 UNT/ML concentration does not express the labelled range or age-dependent reconstitution volume.
suggestion: Vibrio cholerae CVD 103-HGR strain live antigen Powder for Oral Suspension [Vaxchora]
